gaia_manifest.query: SELECT TOP 10000 source_id,ra,dec,ref_epoch,parallax,parallax_error,pmra,pmdec,phot_g_mean_mag,bp_rp,ruwe,astrometric_params_solved,visibility_periods_used,phot_bp_rp_excess_factor,duplicated_source FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',53.1364166667,-27.789,0.1)) ORDER BY source_id

allwise_manifest.query: SELECT TOP 10000 designation,ra,dec,w1mpro,w2mpro,w1sigmpro,w2sigmpro,w1snr,w2snr,cc_flags,ext_flg,nb,ph_qual FROM allwise_p3as_psd WHERE CONTAINS(POINT(ra,dec),CIRCLE(53.1364166667,-27.789,0.1))=1 ORDER BY designation

reference_manifest.layer: Gaia DR3 published AllWISE best neighbours

probes.null: uniform surface density in the cone; selection/crowding can violate this

gaia_screen.interpretation: Exploratory screening only. Permutation exchangeability within coarse bins is an approximation; no calibrated physical probability or novelty claim. No confirmation data used.
gaia_screen.selection: No quality filtering; missingness retained. Two-magnitude bins condition selected relationships on depth; sky quadrants condition brightness tests. Magnitude is not distance. Faint-end completeness not measured.

crossmatch.caveat: Geometric candidates, not object identities. Gaia epoch 2016 versus AllWISE ~2010; no proper-motion propagation. Resolution, depth, blending and upper limits can explain nonmatches. AllWISE adds infrared wavelength coverage, not a universal fainter optical limit.

published_calibration.meaning: Reproduces published catalog associations; this validates a crossmatch, not a new physical finding or a full deep-field rediscovery.

infrared_followup.interpretation: Two follow-up tests per field selected after Gaia screening; 20 total scientific tests including the original 16. Adjusted p is descriptive, not independent confirmation. SNR>=5 in both WISE bands and one-to-one candidates used for color tests; excluded/flagged sources remain in the raw catalog and match record.
